messages.author: e06a19bd5ee21848
messages.subject: Application stops unexpectedly
parts:
I have recently returned to my shiny-server installation after a long absence. The apps were all written (and successfully deployed on a local server) about 18 months ago.

In the past week I have rebuilt my server which is now running UBUNTU 14.04 and the latest shiny-server.

I copied my previous apps across to the /srv/shiny-server/ folder and have verified they work by successfully running them from within R-studio.

The problem is when I try to run them from a browser either on the LAN or WAN I get the error message: "The application unexpectedly exited. Diagnostic information has been dumped to the JavaScript error console".

I realize this issue has been raised and discussed previously. One suggested fix was to increase the app time-out settings in the shiny-server.conf file which I did but to no effect.

The message is not generated immediately - the app is clearly running as it displays some of the ui.R stuff header, tabs, slider bars drop down lists etc.) but seems to come to a halt about the point where a plot is to be displayed. I was thinking this may be a permission issue and so changed the folder and ui.R and server.R permissions to 777. However this did not resolve the issue.

You are welcome to run the app yourself. It can be accessed at: http://bit.ly/1xSntVU


Any suggestions most welcome.

Cheers,
David.

messages.subject: Re: Application stops unexpectedly
parts:
Here's what the error message says:

Listening on http://127.0.0.1:52856
Loading required package: reshape2
Warning in library(package, lib.loc = lib.loc, character.only = TRUE, logical.return = TRUE,  :
  there is no package called ‘reshape2’
Loading required package: plotrix
Warning in library(package, lib.loc = lib.loc, character.only = TRUE, logical.return = TRUE,  :
  there is no package called ‘plotrix’
Loading required package: chron
Warning in library(package, lib.loc = lib.loc, character.only = TRUE, logical.return = TRUE,  :
  there is no package called ‘chron’
Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) : could not find function "melt"

It looks like you're missing a bunch of packages. Keep in mind they need to be installed in either the site library or the "shiny" user's personal library, not the personal library of whoever you usually log in as.

To install in the site library you could do

sudo su - \
  -c "R -e \"install.packages(c('reshape2', 'plotrix', 'chron'), repos='http://cran.rstudio.com/')\""

messages.subject: Re: Application stops unexpectedly
parts:
Hi Joe,

Thanks for the advice. I had determined that those packages were missing but, as you pointed out, I had installed them under my own login library.

Incidentally, I ran the command you suggested:


sudo su - \

which seemed to install the packages but now I can't even access the shiny-server from either LAN or WAN (even the default app on port 3838 is not accessible). Not sure if this is related to any changes above?

David.
